mapper.select: SELECT tdm53_company_id AS company_id , tdm53_check_ym AS check_ym , tdm53_role_id AS role_id FROM tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt INNER JOIN tdm53_chck_exct ON tdm53_chck_exct_id = tdm59_chck_exct_id WHERE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id = #{chckApprCmntId}

SELECT (COALESCE(tdm50_end_yn, 'false') = 'true') AS end_yn , TO_CHAR(tdm50_end_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS end_date , COALESCE(( SELECT tdm91_batch_appr_use_yn = 'true' FROM tdm91_company_setup WHERE tdm91_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm91_start_date <= tdm50_start_date ORDER BY tdm91_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ), false) AS batch_appr_use_yn FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm}

SELECT tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id AS chck_appr_cmnt_id , tdm59_chck_exct_id AS chck_exct_id , tdm59_appr_org_id AS appr_org_id , tdm59_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id , tdm59_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_code , tdm59_appr_cmnt AS appr_cmnt , tdm59_report_cmnt AS report_cmnt , f_org_nm(tdm59_appr_org_id, #{stdDate}) AS appr_org_name FROM tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt WHERE tdm59_chck_exct_id = #{chckExctId} AND tdm59_appr_org_id = #{parentOrgId} AND tdm59_cmnt_type = 'SUB' AND tdm59_child_org_id = #{orgId}

SELECT tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id AS chck_appr_cmnt_id , tdm59_chck_exct_id AS chck_exct_id , tdm59_appr_org_id AS appr_org_id , tdm59_appr_emp_id AS appr_emp_id , tdm59_appr_status_cd AS appr_status_code , tdm59_appr_cmnt AS appr_cmnt , tdm59_report_cmnt AS report_cmnt , f_org_nm(tdm59_appr_org_id, #{stdDate}) AS appr_org_name FROM tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt WHERE tdm59_chck_exct_id = #{chckExctId} AND tdm59_appr_org_id = #{childOrgId} AND tdm59_cmnt_type = 'SELF'
mapper.update: UPDATE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt SET tdm59_submit_yn = CAST(#{submitYn} AS varchar) , tdm59_submit_date = CASE WHEN #{submitYn} = 'true' THEN f_sysdate() ELSE NULL END WHERE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id = #{chckApprCmntId}

UPDATE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt SET tdm59_appr_status_cd = CAST(#{apprStatusCode} AS varchar) , tdm59_appr_cmnt = CAST(#{apprCmnt} AS text) , tdm59_report_cmnt = CAST(#{reportCmnt} AS text) WHERE tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id = #{chckApprCmntId}
mapper.select: SELECT org00_kor_nm FROM ( SELECT tdm51_chck_org_id , tdm51_org_id FROM tdm51_chck_org WHERE tdm51_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm51_check_ym = #{checkYm} AND tdm51_role_id = #{roleId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id ) EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT tdm51_chck_org_id , tdm51_org_id FROM tdm53_chck_exct INNER JOIN tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt ON tdm59_chck_exct_id = tdm53_chck_exct_id INNER JOIN tdm62_chck_cmnt_relate_org ON tdm62_chck_appr_cmnt_id = tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm62_chck_org_id WHERE tdm53_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm53_check_ym = #{checkYm} AND tdm53_role_id = #{roleId} AND tdm59_cmnt_type = 'SELF' ) t INNER JOIN getOrg(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}) ON org00_org_id = tdm51_org_id

SELECT t.tdm54_chck_insuff_id AS chck_insuff_id , t.tdm54_chck_manl_id AS chck_manl_id , t.tdm54_company_id AS company_id , t.tdm54_role_id AS role_id , t.tdm54_org_id AS org_id , t.tdm54_org_nm AS org_name , t.tdm54_check_ym AS check_ym , TO_CHAR(t.tdm54_reg_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS reg_date , TO_CHAR(t.tdm54_due_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS due_date , TO_CHAR(t.tdm54_action_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS action_date , t.tdm54_plan_reg_emp_nm AS plan_reg_emp_name , t.tdm54_plan_action_emp_nm AS plan_action_emp_name , t.tdm54_action_emp_nm AS action_emp_name , t.tdm54_action_nm AS action_name , t.tdm54_action_plan AS action_plan , t.tdm54_action_cmnt AS action_cmnt , t.tdm54_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('TdmInsuffStatus', curr_status_cd, tdm54_company_id, tdm54_reg_date) AS status_name , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS action_emp_info , CAST(NULL AS boolean) AS curr_month_occ_yn , CAST(NULL AS boolean) AS first_appr_emp_yn , CAST(NULL AS boolean) AS final_appr_emp_yn , CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS chck_insuff_appr_id , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS appr_status_code , CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS appr_status_name , CAST(NULL AS text) AS appr_cmnt FROM ( SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff.* , tdm51_check_ym AS tdm54_check_ym /*발생년월*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_plan_reg_emp_id) AS tdm54_plan_reg_emp_nm /*조치계획등록자*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_plan_action_emp_id) AS tdm54_plan_action_emp_nm /*조치예정자*/ , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm54_action_emp_id) AS tdm54_action_emp_nm /*조치자*/ , f_org_nm(tdm54_org_id, f_today()) AS tdm54_org_nm /*부서명*/ , CASE WHEN tdm51_check_ym = TO_CHAR(f_today(),'YYYY.MM') THEN '10' WHEN tdm54_status_cd IN ('19','20','21','25','26') THEN tdm54_status_cd ELSE '11' END AS curr_status_cd FROM tdm54_chck_insuff INNER JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_manl_id = tdm54_chck_manl_id INNER JOIN tdm51_chck_org ON tdm51_chck_org_id = tdm52_chck_org_id INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm54_role_id WHERE tdm54_chck_insuff_id = #{chckInsuffId} ) t

SELECT tdm63_chck_insuff_record_id AS chck_insuff_record_id , TO_CHAR(tdm63_reg_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS reg_date , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm63_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name , tdm63_content AS content , tdm63_note AS note , f_get_tdmEvidCount(tdm63_chck_insuff_record_id) || '건' AS file_count_str FROM tdm63_chck_insuff_record WHERE tdm63_chck_insuff_id = #{chckInsuffId} ORDER BY tdm63_reg_date, tdm63_chck_insuff_record_id
